raw_text:
# 12-Week Strength Programme — Advanced Lifter, 20 Weeks Pregnant

**Client snapshot:** 30F, advanced training history, currently 20 weeks pregnant. Programme runs from week 20 to week 32 of pregnancy. OB cleared for moderate strength training.

## Guiding Principles

- **No supine work** (already past week 16) — incline bench minimum 15–30°, or use standing/seated variations.
- **No max attempts, no 1RM testing.** Cap intensity at RPE 7 early, dropping to RPE 5–6 by the final phase. Always leave 3+ reps in reserve (RIR).
- **Talk test / Borg 12–14.** If she can't hold a short conversation, dial it back.
- **No Valsalva / prolonged breath-holds.** Exhale on exertion.
- **Monitor for:** bleeding, fluid leakage, contractions, dizziness, shortness of breath, calf pain, headache, reduced fetal movement — stop and refer immediately.
- **Avoid:** prone positions (week 24+ or whenever uncomfortable), heavy bilateral loaded forward flexion late term, jumping/plyometrics, anything with fall risk (overhead heavy barbell, single-leg unsupported balance work late term).
- **Diastasis recti check** every 2–3 weeks. Watch for coning/doming during any core work — regress immediately.
- **Pelvic floor work** integrated daily (breath-coordinated, not just kegels).
- **Joint laxity** increases through pregnancy (relaxin) — keep ranges of motion controlled, avoid end-range loaded positions.
- **Thermoregulation:** cool environment, hydration, no training in heat.

---

## Phase 1 — Strength Maintenance (Weeks 1–4 of programme / Weeks 20–23 pregnancy)

**Goal:** Maintain strength with moderate loads. 3 full-body sessions/week. RPE cap 7, 3+ RIR.

### Session A — Lower-Focus
| Exercise | Sets × Reps | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Goblet box squat (parallel box) | 4 × 6–8 @ RPE 6 | Wider stance as belly grows |
| Trap bar deadlift | 4 × 5 @ RPE 7 | Higher handles, neutral spine |
| DB walking lunge | 3 × 8/leg | Controlled |
| Incline DB bench press (30°) | 3 × 8 | |
| Half-kneeling cable row | 3 × 10/side | |
| Side plank (knees down OK) | 3 × 20–30 sec/side | No coning |
| Diaphragmatic breathing + pelvic floor | 2 × 8 breaths | Cooldown |

### Session B — Upper-Focus
| Exercise | Sets × Reps | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Landmine press (standing) | 4 × 6–8 @ RPE 6 | |
| Chest-supported row (incline bench, chest up) | 4 × 8 | |
| DB Romanian deadlift | 3 × 8 @ RPE 6 | |
| Step-up (12" box) | 3 × 8/leg | |
| Half-kneeling Pallof press | 3 × 10/side | Anti-rotation core |
| Farmer carry | 3 × 30 m | Moderate load |

### Session C — Full-Body
| Exercise | Sets × Reps | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Front-foot-elevated split squat | 4 × 6/leg @ RPE 6 | |
| Hip thrust (back on bench, head supported, slight incline) | 4 × 8 @ RPE 6 | Stop if any supine discomfort; sub for elevated glute bridge |
| Lat pulldown | 3 × 10 | |
| Single-arm DB press (standing) | 3 × 8/side | |
| Bird-dog | 3 × 8/side | Watch for coning |
| Suitcase carry | 3 × 30 m/side | |

**Conditioning:** 2 × 20–30 min low-impact (incline walking, stationary bike, swimming) on off days.

---

## Phase 2 — Strength Sustain with Volume Drop (Weeks 5–8 of programme / Weeks 24–27 pregnancy)

**Goal:** Maintain strength as bump and fatigue grow. Drop volume ~15%, hold intensity at RPE 6 cap, 4+ RIR. Begin substituting any prone/loaded supine work.

**Key swaps from Phase 1:**
- **Hip thrust → elevated glute bridge or single-leg hip thrust with torso ≥30°** (or eliminate if reflux/discomfort).
- **Trap bar deadlift → block-pull trap bar** (reduce ROM as belly limits hip hinge depth).
- **Goblet squat → heels-elevated goblet squat or KB sumo squat** to keep torso upright.
- **Side plank → side plank from knees** only.
- **Bird-dog → quadruped opposite arm-only reaches** if quadruped becomes uncomfortable.

### Sample Phase 2 Session A
| Exercise | Sets × Reps |
|---|---|
| Heels-elevated goblet squat | 3 × 6–8 @ RPE 6 |
| Block-pull trap bar DL | 3 × 5 @ RPE 6 |
| Reverse lunge (DB) | 3 × 8/leg |
| Incline DB bench (30–45°) | 3 × 8 |
| Half-kneeling cable row | 3 × 10/side |
| Pallof press | 3 × 10/side |
| Box breathing + pelvic floor release | 5 min cooldown |

**Frequency:** 3×/week, but allow flexibility — if she shows up tired, drop a set per exercise, not the session.

**Conditioning:** 2–3 × 20 min walking or swimming. Heart rate guided by talk test, not numbers.

---

## Phase 3 — Movement Quality & Birth Prep (Weeks 9–12 of programme / Weeks 28–31 pregnancy)

**Goal:** Reduce load, maintain pattern fluency, build positional endurance for labour, manage pelvic girdle discomfort. RPE cap 5–6, 4–5 RIR. 2–3 sessions/week, mostly full-body, shorter (~45 min).

**Major shifts:**
- **Reduce barbell work.** DBs, KBs, cables, machines preferred for safety and ease of setup around the belly.
- **Drop bilateral hinging** if hip/pelvis discomfort (SPD) appears — go split-stance.
- **No more lunge variations if pelvic instability presents.** Sub box step-ups.
- **Add labour-specific positional work:** deep supported squats, side-lying breathing, quadruped pelvic tilts.

### Sample Phase 3 Session
| Exercise | Sets × Reps | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Box squat to high box | 3 × 6 @ RPE 5 | Upright torso |
| KB suitcase RDL | 3 × 6/side @ RPE 5 | Split stance |
| Step-up (low box) | 3 × 6/leg | |
| Landmine press | 3 × 8 | |
| Seated cable row | 3 × 10 | |
| Wall sit with breathing | 2 × 20–30 sec | Birth prep |
| Supported deep squat hold | 3 × 30 sec | Hold rig/TRX, open hips |
| Side-lying 90/90 breathing | 5 min | Pelvic floor down-training |

**Conditioning:** Daily walking 20–30 min, swimming if available.

---

## Auto-Regulation Rules (every phase)

- If she rates session readiness ≤5/10, drop top sets by one and cap RPE at 5.
- If any movement causes coning, leaking, pelvic pain, or round ligament pain, regress or remove that movement for the rest of the programme.
- Re-test setup positioning every 2 weeks — belly changes will dictate stance widths, grip widths, and ROM.
- After week 28, consider every session "the last good one" — no chasing PRs ever, and be ready to deload further.

## Recovery & Lifestyle

- **Sleep:** Side-lying (left preferred) with pillow between knees. 8+ hours target.
- **Nutrition:** Defer specifics to her OB/dietitian. General notes: ~340 extra kcal/day in T2, ~450 in T3; prioritise protein (~1.6–1.8 g/kg pre-pregnancy bodyweight), iron-rich foods, hydration (~3 L/day, more if training).
- **Mobility/recovery sessions:** 1–2 per week of 20 min: cat-cow, 90/90 hip work, thoracic rotations, calf stretching, supported child's pose.
- **Pelvic floor PT referral:** Strongly recommend a session with a pelvic floor physio during Phase 2 to baseline her for postpartum return.

## Return-to-Training Note

At week 12 of the programme she'll be ~32 weeks pregnant. Plan a brief **Phase 4 (weeks 32–delivery)**: bodyweight, breathing, walking, supported squat holds, side-lying work only. Then a structured **postpartum return-to-lifting protocol** beginning after her 6-week (or later, depending on delivery) clearance — happy to build that out when she's ready.
